thread:
amanda: starting edge-router cutover v1.14.2 -> v1.15.0. change window 10:30-11:00 UTC. plan: 10% every 2m, hold 5m at 50%. ping @ops-oncall for anomalies.

deploy-bot: RELEASE STARTED: id=0xdef456 target=edge-router:v1.15.0 policy=linear(10%/2m) hold=50%

tj: can we enable auto-rollback on 5xx>2.5% and a circuit-breaker for connection failures?

nora: added "hold-on-5xx" rule at 2.5% and short-circuit for conn-fail >1%. canary scoped to eu-west for first 15m.

mike: reminder: don't drain old nodes until warm cache seeding completes. i'll observe per-route p95 and connection churn.

router-bot: TRAFFIC SHIFT: 10%->v1.15.0, 90%->v1.14.2. healthchecks OK. metrics p95=118ms, 5xx=0.4%

amanda: analytics route showing 3.8% 5xx last 1m from tokenizer downstream. flagging.

ops-oncall: pausing canary. `deployctl shift --id 0xdef456 --pause`

deploy-bot: ACTION: shift paused at 20% by ops-oncall. state preserved.

tj: logs show OOMs in tokenizer pods eu-west-1. restarting with doubled memory now. will redeploy canary pod.

nora: if tokenizer restarts, KV cache drop likely. prefer keep shift paused until caches repopulate and p95 stabilizes.

amanda: quick probe: `curl -s https://edge-internal/health?route=analytics | jq .` -> {analytics:200, tokenizer:errors=14, p95=420ms}

ops-oncall: proposal: pin analytics to stable v1.14.2, allow other routes to continue shift. targeted rollback for route-level issue.

tj: running pin: `routerctl pin --route analytics --version v1.14.2 --until 11:00` — executing.

deploy-bot: ACTION: route-pinned analytics -> v1.14.2 by tj. analytics traffic now 100% old.

amanda: resuming shift for non-analytics routes. watch two cycles (4m) for regressions. :eyes:

router-bot: SHIFT RESUME: aggregated 30% new / 70% old. global p95=132ms, 5xx trending down to 0.9%.

mike: starting slow-drain annotation on older nodes: `kubectl annotate node/edge-07 drain-window=90s` to keep overlap for cache warm.

ops-oncall: follow-ups: add tokenizer mem-sanity pre-check to deploy pipeline, increase canary size for stateful routes, doc targeted-pin playbook. filing INF-2157.

amanda: recording notes for release notes: "analytics pinned to v1.14.2 due to tokenizer memory hot path; tokenizer mem bump in next patch; resumed shift for other routes." good work team. :thumbsup:
